messages:
mara: FYI I opened a docs PR to tighten the disconnected/private installer steps and add a short HSM plugin v2.3 troubleshooting section. Need net + KMS reviewers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :eyes:

jonathan: Skimmed it — overall good. Two quick things: the systemd unit in the installer example missing Restart=on-failure, and the socat example to verify PKCS#11 socket needs to be clearer.

mara: thanks. added Restart line in the draft. here's the current unit I pasted into the doc:

```
[Unit]
Description=Redwood Private Installer
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-installer start --offline
Restart=on-failure
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

sasha: small nit: can we show the SELinux label suggestion for the socket path? some customers run targeted SELinux policies. Something like: `chcon -t socket_t /var/run/hsm/slot0` (or add a note to consult their security team).

oliver: Also adding the quick KMS connectivity check I used when debugging yesterday: if the HSM exposes a unix socket, you can peek at it with: `socat - UNIX-CONNECT:/var/run/hsm/slot0,echo=0` — the doc should warn that this is just a liveness/handshake check, not a functional test.

mara: good call, i'll add both. jonathan can you paste your exact socat line for the doc?

jonathan: sure — for customers using PKCS11 proxy we wrote this one: `socat -t 5 -d -d STDIO OPEN:/var/run/pkcs11-proxy.sock` and then send a minimal init packet in the app. I'll add a short paragraph explaining expected output (no plaintext secrets, just OK/ERR codes).

oliver: on the networking side, the installer's offline bundle bootstraps nodes but some teams hit ephemeral port blocks on egress during artifact fetch fallback. Suggest a tiny table: egress TCP 443 to object store, UDP 123 for time (if using chrony), and ephemeral TCP 30000-32767 for kube CNI.

mara: adding a compact port matrix. also adding checksum verification steps — example I want to include: `sha256sum redwood-offline-1.2.0.tar.gz` and verify against the manifest signature.

jonathan: can we include a one-liner to verify signature with gpg? customers asked for it in docs earlier. e.g.: `gpg --verify redwood-offline-1.2.0.tar.gz.sig redwood-offline-1.2.0.tar.gz` — and mention expected key id (link to our keyring doc).

sasha: PR comment: the HSM section references slot IDs that don't exist on some YubiHSM configs — recommend we add a troubleshooting bullet: "If your HSM reports wrong slot count, check PKCS11 module version and vendor utils (e.g., pkcs11-tool -L)". Could add a short pkcs11-tool example: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libykcs11.so -L`

mara: done, added the pkcs11-tool example and a short note about vendor module path being vendor-specific.

docs-bot: Checklist: docs lint OK, linkcheck failed for one internal link (https://redwood-internal/docs/private/key-rotation) — @mara please update or mark as internal-only.

mara: thanks docs-bot — i've replaced that link with the customer-facing rotation guide and left an internal reference in a comment.

jonathan: one more thought — the installer troubleshooting should include a minimal diag command to gather network info to paste into support tickets: `redwood-installer collect-logs --include network,sysinfo --output /tmp/redwood-support.tar.gz`

mara: added the collect-logs line and a short paragraph describing what to redact before sharing (keys, certs).

oliver: can someone from QA confirm the nftables -> legacy-iptables example? I added a snippet for customers migrating older firewall policies to nft, but i want to avoid suggesting a config that breaks SNAT ordering.

sasha: i'll ask QA to sanity-check. quick note for the doc: recommend "test in a staging VPC with identical routing table entries before rolling to prod" — customers ignore that, but we should say it. :grin:

mara: great. thanks all — i'm going to push an update in ~30m with those changes and ping reviewers. if anyone wants to squash small wording edits before i merge, drop them here. :thumbsup:
